title: OneTrustRequest
description: One message on the outbound FIFO queue (cpms-sqs-outbound.fifo): a complete, ready-to-send HTTP request to OneTrust's Create Consent Receipts API. The dispatcher sends method/url/headers/body exactly as given. Produced by step 4, validated against this schema by step 5. 'body' follows OneTrust's published request schema (https://developer.onetrust.com/onetrust/reference/createconsentreceiptusingpost); constraints marked 'CPMS rule' are stricter than OneTrust and exist for this pipeline's guarantees. OneTrust performs no data-type validation on this API, so this schema is the only check before data lands in OneTrust.

url.description: OneTrust Consent Receipts endpoint on one of OneTrust's published hosts. '/identified' is the identified-receipt variant (same body).

authorization.description: Optional per OneTrust: a signed JWT verifiable with the public key configured in OneTrust; its 'sub' claim should match body.identifier. The collection point JWT in body.requestInformation is normally sufficient.

correlationId.description: Carried from the canonical header — ties the OneTrust call back to the source event. Not sent to OneTrust.

identifier.description: The data subject's identifier (for us: the lowercased email = canonical subject.subjectId). Required by OneTrust.

identifierType.description: e.g. 'Email'. Required by OneTrust for dynamic-configuration collection points.

requestInformation.description: The collection point's JWT, used unaltered — from the collection point's Integrations tab or the Get Collection Point Token API. Required by OneTrust; it is also the request's authorization.

interactionDate.description: When the data subject interacted (= the items' capturedAt). CPMS rule: required — OneTrust uses it to ignore receipts older than the last recorded interaction ('will create a transaction but will not update the purpose status'), which is our out-of-order guard at OneTrust's end. OneTrust rejects a post that sends interactionDate together with any other date, so no other date fields are allowed here.

purposes.description: OneTrust: no more than 10 recommended, absolute maximum 20 per receipt. CPMS rule: at least 1 (a receipt with no purposes changes nothing).

test.description: OneTrust: once a subject is marked test=true it cannot be reverted to false.

customPayload.description: OneTrust: total size must not exceed 4000 characters (not expressible in JSON Schema — checked in step 5 code).

enableDataElementDateValidation.description: When true, data elements are overwritten only if this receipt's interactionDate is later than the subject's last update — the same out-of-order protection for dsDataElements.

consentReceipt.$comment: The 'not' clause encodes OneTrust's rule that generateInstantLinkToken cannot be combined with shortLinkToken.

Id.description: The purpose's OneTrust ID (from the taxonomy mapping).

TransactionType.description: OneTrust: optional and only supported for API-type collection points; allowed values also depend on collection point settings (e.g. PENDING only with double opt-in). CPMS rule: required — we always state the decision explicitly rather than relying on collection point defaults.

Preferences.description: Topic choices under this purpose. Not supported on Web Form collection points.

Options.description: Only the options the subject should be opted INTO.

Choices.description: Explicit per-option opt in/out — used with TransactionType CHANGE_PREFERENCES.

ReactivationDate.description: OneTrust: only valid when TransactionType is WITHDRAWN or OPT_OUT.
